criteria.text: Is the agent's stated reasoning consistent with the edits it actually made and the feedback it received (no post-hoc rationalization, no lucky guess)?
Did each refinement stage (lint, test) do real, feedback-responsive work toward the solution rather than cosmetic or no-op changes?

The FormatDiagnosticsHost implementation returns the TS system's current directory from getCurrentDirectory() and the TS system's newline string from getNewLine(), deriving both from the runtime TS system rather than hard-coded values.

The fileLine string is computed only when the diagnostic has an associated file AND a defined start (using an explicit start-not-undefined/null check, not truthiness so start===0 is kept), and formats as fileName(line,character) with 1-based line and character numbers.
printDiagnostics routes each diagnostic to the correct context method by category: Message→info, Error→error, Warning and any unknown/default→warn.
The selected print method is invoked with the Rollup context as receiver (via .call/bind or an arrow capturing context) so that error's bail/abort semantics function.
expandIncludeWithDirs joins each include entry (string or string[]) to each root directory and normalizes the result, iterating roots outermost and includes innermost.

createFilter, when the tsconfig has projectReferences, additionally expands included and excluded globs using each reference's path property (not the reference object), concatenating expanded entries first followed by original entries.
createFilter emits two debug callbacks reporting the final included and excluded arrays, and returns a filter resolved against parsedConfig.options.rootDir.

The LanguageServiceHost implements reset() to clear snapshots/versions, getScriptFileNames() returning tracked names as an array, and getScriptVersion(fileName) which normalizes the path and returns the numeric version (default 0) as a string.

getCustomTransformers() returns undefined when there is no service or no/empty transformers, otherwise invokes each transformer factory with the service and merges before/after/afterDeclarations without crashing when a factory omits any of them.

criteria.text: getCompilationSettings() returns the parsed compiler options, getTypeRootsVersion() returns 0, getCurrentDirectory() returns the configured cwd, and useCaseSensitiveFileNames() mirrors the TS system's setting.
